'''Marc Mézard''' (born 29 August 1957) is a [[French people|French]] [[physicist]] and academic [[Academic administration|administrator]]. He was, from 2012 to 2022, the director of the ''[[École normale supérieure (Paris)|École normale supérieure]]'' (ENS). He is the co-author of two books.

==Early life==
Marc Mézard was born on 29 August 1957.<ref name="letudiantbio">{{cite web|title=BIOGRAPHIE DE MARC MÉZARD|url=http://www.letudiant.fr/educpros/personnalites/mezard-marc-824.html|website=letudiant.fr|accessdate=October 29, 2016}}</ref> He graduated from the ''[[École normale supérieure (Paris)|École normale supérieure]]'' in 1976 and earned the ''[[agrégation]]'' in Physics.<ref name="institutens">{{cite web|title=Qui sommes-nous? Marc Mézard, Vice-Président de l'Institut|url=http://institutens.fr/marc-mezard/|website=Institut de l'École Normale Supérieure|publisher=École Normale Supérieure|accessdate=October 29, 2016}}</ref> He earned a PhD in Physics from [[University of Paris 6]] in 1980.<ref>{{Cite thesis|url=http://www.sudoc.abes.fr//DB=2.1/SET=2/TTL=1/CLK?IKT=1016&TRM=TEST+DE+QCD+ET+OBSERVABLES+INCLUSIVES+DANS+LA+DIFFUSION+INELASTIQUE+DE+NEUTRINOS|title = Test de QCD et Observables Inclusives dans la Diffusion Inelastique de Neutrinos|year = 1980|publisher = Université Pierre et Marie Curie|last1 = Mézard|first1 = Marc}}</ref><ref name="apsprize">{{cite web|title=2016 Lars Onsager Prize Recipient|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/prizes/prizerecipient.cfm?last_nm=Mezard&first_nm=Marc&year=2016|website=[[American Physical Society]]|accessdate=October 29, 2016}}</ref>

==Career==
Mézard joined the ''[[Centre national de la recherche scientifique]]'' (CNRS) as a researcher in 1981.<ref name="institutens"/><ref name="apsprize"/> He was a professor of Physics at the ''[[École Polytechnique]]''.<ref name="letudiantbio"/> In 2001, he joined the Center for Theoretical Physics and Statistical Models at the [[University of Paris-Sud]], and he serves as its director.<ref name="institutens"/> Since 2012 to 2022, he had also served as the director of his alma mater, the ENS.<ref name="institutens"/> In 2022 he joined the Department of the Computing Sciences at the [[Bocconi University]] in [[Milan]].<ref>{{Cite web |orig-date=01 February 2022 |title=Sei nuovi docenti allargano gli orizzonti della Bocconi |url=https://www.knowledge.unibocconi.it/notizia.php?idArt=23791 |website=knowledge.unibocconi.it |date=February 2022 |language=it}}</ref>

Mézard is the author of 170 academic articles and the co-author of two books.<ref name="institutens"/> He won the [[Prize Ampère]] in 1996,<ref name="letudiantbio"/> the [[Humboldt Prize]] in 2009,<ref name="cnrslaureatsfrancais">{{cite web|title=Lauréats français du prix Humboldt 2009|url=http://www.cnrs.fr/inp/spip.php?article284|website=CNRS|accessdate=October 29, 2016|date=January 29, 2010}}</ref> and the [[Lars Onsager Prize]] in 2016.<ref name="apsprize"/>

In 2026, he was awarded the [[Dirac Medal (ICTP)|ICTP Dirac Medal]] for his contributions to [[statistical mechanics]].<ref>[https://www.ictp.it/news/2026/8/ictp-announces-2026-dirac-medal-recipients Dirac Medallists 2026]</ref>
